summary: Iteration 8 regression + SEO/GEO validation after full 51k page corpus generation and dynamic sitemap rewrite. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed (health, services=14, freelancers list, lead creation, admin login+me+wrong-creds, sitemap index has 13 children, shard 1 = 5000 URLs, shard 11 = 1002 URLs, total = 51,005 URLs, spot-checked first/middle/last locs of shards 1/6/11 all resolve 200, /robots.txt frontend + /api/robots.txt both contain GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended + correct canonical Sitemap line, /llms.txt returns markdown, /api/seo/sitemaps-manifest returns totalPublicUrls=51005 with indexingGuidance and no googlePingUrl, /api/seo/audit?sample=100 returns passedCount=100 errorCount=0 duplicateCanonicalsFound=0). Frontend (headless chromium): home renders hero + Post a Requirement modal opens successfully, /admin exposes login form and sets meta robots=noindex,nofollow, deep link /locations/india/mumbai/freelance-web-developer/ renders <data-testid=service-location-page>, brief form visible, document.title contains 'Mumbai' ('Freelance Website Designer & Developer in Mumbai | ER Freelancer'), page-specific meta description, canonical link ends with the page path using preview origin, and 2 JSON-LD blocks present.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/seo.py loads all pages into memory in seo_audit() (~51k docs). Fine at current scale but should be streamed if corpus grows.
sitemap-blog.xml is included in the index even when there are 0 blog posts (returns an empty <urlset>). Not an error but could be conditionally omitted.
child_sitemaps + shard_count run count_documents on every /api/sitemap.xml hit; consider a short in-memory TTL cache to reduce DB pressure from crawlers.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing 51,002 approved pages. Created 1 TEST_ lead as part of regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sitemap corpus is now dynamic from Mongo. Total public URLs = 51005 (3 core + 0 blog + 51002 approved pages) across 11 page shards + core + blog = 13 sitemap children. Canonical origin comes from backend/.env PRODUCTION_CANONICAL_DOMAIN (currently the preview URL). Frontend applySeo() correctly updates title/description/canonical/JSON-LD on route change. No blockers.
